method.lighthouse_preset: mobile (default), simulated throttling, headless Chrome, a fresh profile each run

lcp_script_placement.question: Does where the Weft page loads its island script change its Lighthouse LCP?
lcp_script_placement.method: bench/tools/lcp-experiment.mjs: hand-edited copies of the built Weft page and the two Astro pages, all served by bench/static (GOMAXPROCS=1, gzip on the fly) on 127.0.0.1:4303; Lighthouse 5 mobile runs each, interleaved, with simulated (Lantern) and with DevTools throttling. lcp_breakdown_ms is Lighthouse's LCP breakdown insight, read from the trace Lighthouse recorded: unthrottled under simulate (only lcp_ms is simulated), throttled under devtools.

inline_css.method: raw: UTF-8 bytes of the <style> element's content. br_alone: that CSS compressed on its own. br_share: the page's brotli size minus the brotli size of the page with the CSS removed.

hydration_markers.method: Every match of /<!--(\[|\]|\{|\}|)-->/ in the page: <!--[--> <!--]--> <!--{--> <!--}--> <!---->. outside_islands leaves out those inside <weft-island>...</weft-island>; br_share is the page's brotli size minus that of the page with those removed.
